source:
May 20th 2012, 11:05. Renmaru Miyabidou receives a mysterious email:
 "Today at noon—a lone girl will leave this world."
 "Killed—at the top floor of Integral..."
 "The girl's name is Myuu... I'm sure you're familiar with that name."
 "Remember the promise—the vow—you made that day... Renmaru."


Public Safety police officer Narumi Mishima receives an email from her friend and coworker:
 "Soon, a girl is going to have her life stolen from her."
 "Narumi-senpai, please. Protect her. Please protect Myuu."
 "To stop their plan—the Second Eclipse Project—her existence is a necessity."


The two of them rush to the abandoned Integral hotel building, and what they encounter is beyond belief: a group of people able to use Ψ, a strange special ability.

[Edited from Cyberfront website]
translation:
2012年5月20日，11:05。雅美丸收到一封神秘邮件：
“今天中午——一个女孩将离开这个世界。”
“被杀——在Integral的顶层……”
“女孩的名字是缪……我相信你熟悉这个名字。”
“记住那天的承诺——那个誓言……雅美丸。”


公安部警察�岛成美收到朋友兼同事的邮件：
“很快，一个女孩的生命将被夺走。”
“成美学姐，请保护她。请保护缪。”
“要阻止他们的计划——第二次日蚀计划——她的存在是必不可少的。”


两人急忙赶往废弃的Integral酒店大楼，而他们所遭遇的超乎想象：一群能够使用Ψ——一种奇异特殊能力的人。
